daily.title: The evolving dairy-agriculture ecosystem: Strengthening rural livelihoods and India’s food economy
daily.summary: Strengthening India's rural economy: dairy-led growth boosts livelihoods, productivity, and food security through inclusive markets and innovation. Agriculture and dairying are not parallel activities; they are integral to one rural economy. Farming income follows the calendar. It arrives after the harvest and has to stretch until the next one. Dairying runs on a different clock, bringing in money from routine milk sales throughout the year. The field brings a large seasonal income, and the cowshed brings steady, dependable cash that keeps the household running between harvests and acts as a cushion when weather or prices turn.

daily.title: Small particles, big potential: How nanotechnology is changing life on India’s farms
daily.summary: Nanotechnology on Indian farms promises better nutrient use and profits, with nano-fertilizers reshaping costs, yields, and livelihoods across states. The change comes from particles too small to see. A nanometre is a billionth of a metre; a human hair is about 80,000 nanometres wide. At that scale, materials can exhibit distinct physical and chemical properties. Nutrients applied as foliar sprays may be absorbed through the leaf surface and stomatal openings, potentially improving nutrient delivery under suitable conditions. However, uptake depends on formulation, crop and environment, and smaller particle size does not automatically guarantee higher nutrient-use efficiency.

The move is expected to release around Rs 50,000 crore into the banking system, providing banks with additional liquidity at a time when the system has moved into a deficit.

breaking.title: RBI Clubs 25 Card Payment Circulars Into A Single Framework
breaking.summary: The RBI has clubbed 25 existing circulars, governing debit, credit and prepaid card transactions, under a single regulatory framework. Called the Reserve Bank of India (Digital Payments – Card-based transaction) Directions, 2026 , the new norms look to streamline compliance and security rules for card-based digital payments. The new framework, which comes into force with immediate effect, primarily pertains to banks, non-bank payment system providers, and ecosystem participants under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act.
